'''Rammocate''' was a [[Trade language/Legends|trade]] [[Language/Legends|language]] in use in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]]. The [[Ebruchi]] [[Species/Legends|species]], [[Lugubraa]] elder [[Lorgrombo]], [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] elder [[Ruthic]], and [[Verinos]] spoke Rammocate.<ref name="TUR" />
